content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Officers of the Central Govt. or State Govt. or Union Territory Administrations or Public sector undertaking or Universities or recognized research institutions or semi-government or autonomous bodies or statutory organizations holding analogous posts or with regular service in specified levels. Experience: Holding analogous posts on regular basis in parent cadre or department; or 5 years regular service in Level-10 (Rs. 56100-177500); or 6 years regular service in Level-8 (Rs. 47600-15100); or 7 years regular service in Level-7 (Rs. 44900-142400). Age limit: Maximum 56 years (as on closing date of receipt of application) Other conditions: Applicants are requested to invariably indicate their e-mail and mobile number in their application form.

content_sections.heading: Who Cannot Apply for NCM Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Departmental officers in the feeder category who are in the direct line of promotion shall not be eligible for consideration for appointment on deputation.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Initially for a period of one year which may be extended further. Period of deputation shall ordinarily not exceed three years.

content_sections.heading: How Will NCM Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Deputation through proper channel Assessment by Selection Committee Assessment by Selection Committee at the time of selection for the post.

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Attested copies of ACR/APAR of last five years Vigilance clearance Integrity Certificate Penalty statement for last five years

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NCM Recruitment 2026 Offline
content_sections.text: Forward the application through proper channel to the Commission. Attach attested copies of ACR/APAR of last five years. Attach vigilance clearance, Integrity Certificate and penalty statement for last five years, and vigilance clearance and Integrity Certificate for last ten years. Indicate e-mail and mobile number in the application form. Make sure it reaches by 27 December 2026.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Borrowing Departments are to provide their specific comments/views confirming the relevant Essential Qualification/Work experience possessed by the Candidate.
